resources.string: Check the amount, currency and dates. Save may also fail if storage is unavailable.

Quota usage is utilization, not money saved. This app has no measured token costs for your billing period, so a monetary return cannot be compared. Review the quota utilization and observed coverage below.

The previous PlanPricing used unverified monthly API-equivalent anchors of USD 700 / 3500 / 14000, divided by 4 for weeks and by 6 again for five-hour windows. No verifiable source supports these amounts. They are retained only for compatibility, not displayed as value. Official plan and rate information: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11369540-using-codex-with-your-chatgpt-plan . Model, context and task characteristics affect consumption; quota percent alone cannot establish token costs.
